The guarantee covers the worktree closeout, its recovery paths and the commit it records, which the leaf's integration lands without judging it again. Two other routes by which a leaf's memory reaches its parent line are outside it. A recorded landing runs the knowledge validator and checks that the leaf's history file is closed; it does not recompute the worklist, so an open worklist item does not refuse it. Direct landing has its own gate, and its commit is bound to its admission snapshot, not to the tree that gate judged.
